legend: Reddish-brown, elevated, slightly asymmetrical papule on the upper arm.
The conventional naevus on the left is composed of small, oval melanocytes, with the BAP1-inactivated melanocytoma composed of large, unpigmented, epithelioid melanocytes on the right.

legend: Compound melanocytic proliferation with an intradermal component mixing nests and sheet-like patterns. Focal dense lymphocytic infiltrate (haematoxylin eosin saffron stain).

Dermal component with nests of mainly naevocytoid cells interspaced with loose sheets of large epithelioid melanocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. No mitotic activity. Absence of top-down maturation.

Cytological detail with moderate nuclear pleomorphism within both small and large melanocytes. Note occasional large cells within the discrete nests of smaller naevoid cells. Outside of the nests, the cells are less crowded.
BAP1 immunohistochemistry showing a diffuse loss of expression in the tumour cells (internal controls: intradermal keratinocytes and lymphocytes).
Pure melanocytoma. BAP1 immunohistochemistry showing a diffuse loss of expression in the tumour cells.

Pure BAP1-inactivated melanocytoma. Compound melanocytic proliferation with an intradermal component mixing nests and sheet-like patterns. Focal dense lymphocytic infiltrate (haematoxylin eosin saffron stain).
